documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting To Be Held On Wednesday At 04:30 Pm (Noon) , August 12, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations'), As Amended
Corporate Action: Record Date For Payment Of Dividend 2025-26

analysis.summary: Crestchem Limited reported its financial results for FY 2025-26, showing a total income of Rs. 25.52 Crores and a net profit of Rs. 2.71 Crores. The company declared a final dividend of Rs. 1.50 per equity share and remains entirely debt-free.

guidance.claim: Commercial production for the new MCT Oil project is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of FY 2026-27.
guidance.quote: Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.

guidance.claim: Management expects the subsidiary to contribute significantly to long-term revenue growth and profitability once commissioned.
guidance.quote: The management remains confident that, upon successful commissioning of the project, the subsidiary will contribute meaningfully to the Company's long-term revenue growth and profitability.

guidance.claim: The company intends to strengthen its market position by expanding manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: The Company intends to strengthen its market position by: • Expanding manufacturing capacity.

guidance.claim: The company believes its financial position will improve considerably in the coming years based on recent performance improvements.
guidance.quote: The company is committed to build the business operations within budget and considering that the business operates on a going concern basis, it is believed that financial position of the company will improve very considerably in the coming years, going by the recent last few years improvement in performances as well.

guidance.claim: The company expects it will take a few more years of sustained growth to generate adequate high profits.
guidance.quote: There is a continuous substantial improvement in the performance of the Company; however, it will take few more years for sustained growth before the Company can generate adequate high profits.

demand_outlook.claim: The global and Indian MCT market is experiencing healthy growth due to rising consumer awareness of preventive healthcare and ketogenic diets.
demand_outlook.quote: The global and Indian MCT market continues to witness healthy growth due to increasing consumer awareness regarding preventive healthcare, ketogenic diets, sports nutrition and functional foods.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing demand from pharmaceutical and medical nutrition applications is expected to support long-term industry growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing demand from pharmaceutical and medical nutrition applications, coupled with increasing acceptance of clean-label ingredients, is expected to support long-term industry growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian market presents significant opportunities due to the growth of pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and food processing industries.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian market also presents significant opportunities due to the growth of the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical and food processing industries, coupled with increasing export potential.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is optimistic but finds it difficult to predict market demand and trends due to critical economic conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: Management is reasonably optimistic however, it is difficult to predict the market demand and its trend, due to critical economic conditions created by disturbances due to Covid -19, Ukraine war etc.

capex_expansion.claim: Crestchem incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited as a subsidiary with 75% equity participation to set up an MCT Oil manufacturing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its long-term growth strategy, the Company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited, Bengaluru, as its subsidiary with an equity participation of 75% for setting up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil, a high-value specialty product catering to pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and personal care industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Procurement and installation of plant, machinery, and utilities for the project are currently in progress.
capex_expansion.quote: The procurement and installation of plant and machinery, utilities and other equipment for the project are presently in progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The company proposes to invest, grant loans, or provide guarantees up to Rs. 2.75 Crores in its subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 186(3) and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, consent of members be and is hereby accorded to the Board to invest, give loans or guarantees up to an aggregate amount of Rs.2.75 Crores proposed investment in subsidiary, notwithstanding that the same limits within the permissible limits under Section 186.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively planning to expand and invest in new or start-up businesses in limited liability partnership firms within specialty chemicals.
capex_expansion.quote: As was reported in previous financial year’s Annual Report the Company is now actively planning to expand and invest in new/start up business in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms, within our Speciallity Chemicals and related fields of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: A requisite pilot plant facility for new products is likely to be established at LLP firms in due course.
capex_expansion.quote: Accordingly, requisite pilot plant facility, for such products, is likely to be established by our company at such LLP firms, in due Course.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest in new or startup limited liability partnership firms within its chemical and related operations.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is planning to invest in new/start up business- limited liability partnership firm(s), within our overall chemical and related field of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has assigned project work to a CSIR entity and hopes to establish a pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or later.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review company has assigned the Project Work to one of the entites of CSIR. Company is hopeful for pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization initiatives and efficient procurement practices contributed to improved operating performance.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimisation initiatives, efficient procurement practices and enhanced production planning contributed towards improved operating performance.

margins_costs.claim: Volatility in the prices of coconut oil and palm kernel oil poses a threat to the company.
margins_costs.quote: Volatility in prices of coconut oil and palm kernel oil.

margins_costs.claim: Supply chain disruptions and freight cost fluctuations are identified as threats.
margins_costs.quote: Supply chain disruptions and freight cost fluctuations.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced ongoing price volatilities during the year under review.
margins_costs.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

margins_costs.claim: The company managed to procure raw materials from time to time and improved its sales turnover.
margins_costs.quote: Your company managed to procure raw materials from time to time and has also improved sales turnover during the year under review.

margins_costs.claim: The company is mitigating risks of growing competition through superior cost-effective technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Threats in terms of growing competition remains as usual in every field of business. But we are mitigating the risks by way of superior cost-effective technologies.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently implementing small to medium-sized mandates, resulting in moderate profits.
orders_capacity.quote: At present, the Company is implementing small to medium size mandates and accordingly, the profits too are moderate.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs 1.50 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare a final dividend of Rs 1.50/- (15%) per equity share of Rs. 10/- each, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026

capital_allocation.claim: The company has availed of FD-OD facilities from banks against its own fixed deposits in the routine course of business.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has, from time to time availed of FD-OD facility from banks, against company’s own fixed deposits (FDs), in routine course of Business.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is debt free and has no borrowings from any bank or institution.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has no borrowings from any Bank or any Institution. There are no outstanding interest payments. Our company is debt free.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a 5% maiden dividend for the year 2023-24, subject to shareholder approval.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors pleased to inform that Company has declared 5% Maiden Dividend for the year 2023-24 (Subject to TDS as per Income tax Act) subject to approval of members at ensuing Annual General Meeting.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces project execution risks including procurement timelines, installation schedules, and regulatory approvals.
risks_headwinds.quote: As the project is currently under implementation, the Company continues to monitor project execution risks, including procurement timelines, installation and commissioning schedules, availability of utilities, regulatory approvals, cost escalations and market conditions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exchange rate fluctuations affecting export competitiveness represent a threat to the business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Exchange rate fluctuations affecting export competitiveness.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has a pending income tax demand of Rs. 2,06,000 for a prior period, which it has clarified is not required to be paid.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company has received the notice from I one income tax demand of Rs. 2,06,000/- for prior period is yet pending though as per our company the same is not required to be paid for which we have already submitted our clarification to the income tax department.

risks_headwinds.claim: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disturbances from international events like Covid-19 and the Ukraine war continue to affect the company with prolonged ill effects including supply chain disturbances.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company. The prolonged ill effects including disturbances in the supply chain and such other disturbances continued till the date of this report.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is facing disturbances from international events such as COVID-19 and the Ukraine war.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prolonged ill effects, including supply chain disturbances, have continued up to the date of the report.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prolonged ill effects including disturbances in the supply chain and such other disturbances continued till the date of this report.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces ongoing risks of growing competition in its business fields.
risks_headwinds.quote: Threats in terms of growing competition remains as usual in every field of business.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production for the MCT Oil project is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of FY 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to building business operations within budget and believes its financial position will improve considerably in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The company is committed to build the business operations within budget and considering that the business operates on a going concern basis, it is believed that financial position of the company will improve very considerably in the coming years, going by the recent last few years improvement in performances as well.

management_commitments.claim: The company is hopeful of establishing a pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.
management_commitments.quote: During the year under review company has assigned the Project Work to one of the entites of CSIR. Company is hopeful for pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
